# netactuate_cloud_capacity (Data Source)

Reads a Cloud Capacity.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_capacity" "example" {
  cloud_pool_id = 12345
  location_id   = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_pool_id` (Number) Cloud pool ID to query capacity for.
- `location_id` (Number) Location ID to query capacity for.

### Read-Only

- `capacity` (List of Object) List of cloud package capacity rows for the requested cloud pool and location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capacity))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--capacity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `capacity`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Number)
- `monthly_price` (Number)
- `package_cpu` (Number)
- `package_disk` (Number)
- `package_id` (Number)
- `package_name` (String)
- `package_net` (Number)
- `package_port` (Number)
- `package_ram` (Number)
